# Sam C. Portfolio
> Personal site of Sam C., a full-stack developer and graphic designer in the UK. Featured work includes SENBridge, a SEND-focused AI assistant for parents in England.

This site is a static portfolio. Use the pages below for project details, background, and contact. Prefer the live product URL for SENBridge rather than inferring behaviour from this portfolio alone.

## Pages
- [Home](https://samconnor.uk/): Overview, services, skills, and featured projects
- [Projects](https://samconnor.uk/projects): Full project index
- [About](https://samconnor.uk/about): Background and approach
- [Contact](https://samconnor.uk/contact): Email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and contact form
- [CV](https://samconnor.uk/Samuel_Connor_CV.pdf): Downloadable CV

## Projects
- [SENBridge](https://samconnor.uk/senbridge): SEND-focused AI assistant for parents in England (Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, Google Gemini). Live app: https://senbridge.uk
- [Castle Adventure](https://samconnor.uk/text-game): Text adventure / OOP game
- [Testing Setup](https://samconnor.uk/testing-setup): Open-source testing setup with Jest, Cypress, and GitHub Actions
- [Backend API](https://samconnor.uk/backend-api): Backend API project notes
- [CARECOVID Logo](https://samconnor.uk/carecovid-logo): Logo design case
- [CARECOVID Leaflet](https://samconnor.uk/carecovid-leaflet): Leaflet design case
